billingPage.title: My membership
billingPage.noneBody: You don’t have a membership yet. Compare the tiers and apply; the ADAIG team will follow up with you directly.
billingPage.reviewBody: Your application is with the ADAIG team. Your point of contact will be in touch to complete your membership.
billingPage.rejectedBody: Your application wasn’t approved. Contact the ADAIG team if you have questions, or apply under another tier.
billingPage.invoicingBody: Membership fees aren’t paid online. The ADAIG team handles membership invoicing and renewals directly and will contact you by email.

communityPage.title: Community
communityPage.lead: Online member discussions aren’t available yet. Until they launch, here’s how to connect with other members.
communityPage.discussionsBody: A members-only space for questions and peer exchange is planned. We’ll let members know when it opens.
communityPage.groupsBody: Planned discipline-based groups for AI governance, records and information governance, privacy, data governance, the public sector, and students and early career.
communityPage.workingBody: A proposed cross-functional forum to anticipate emerging risks together. Register your interest to help shape it.
communityPage.eventsBody: The best way to meet peers today: join an upcoming ADAIG event.
communityPage.directoryBody: Find active members who have chosen to be listed.

membership.title: Membership tiers
membership.lead: Choose the membership that fits your role and career stage, then apply. Our team reviews every application and will be in touch to confirm your membership.
membership.duesBody: Membership dues are being finalized by the founding board. Pricing is confirmed when our team contacts you about your application.
membership.studentNote: You’ll be asked to confirm your enrollment when you apply.

join.title: Join ADAIG
join.lead: Tell us about yourself and the membership you’re interested in. There is no payment at this stage: our team reviews your application and will be in touch.
join.emailHint: Your point of contact will use this address to reach you. Joining through your employer? Use your work email.
join.passwordHint: At least 12 characters; not a common password. Spaces, paste and password managers are allowed.
join.dir: List me in the member directory (you can change this anytime)
join.mkt: Yes, email me ADAIG news, events and offers. I can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email.
join.next1: Send us your details with this form. Nothing is charged.
join.next2: The ADAIG team reviews your application. You can follow its status from your dashboard.
join.next3: A member of our team will contact you to confirm your membership, dues and next steps.
join.noPayment: Nothing is charged when you apply. Your point of contact will go over the membership details, including dues, with you.
join.attest: I confirm I am currently enrolled full-time (or in a recognized career-change program) and can provide proof if asked.
join.verifyHint: Our team confirms student eligibility as part of reviewing your application.
join.err_pw_short: Your password must be at least 12 characters.
join.err_pw_long: Your password must be 128 characters or fewer.
join.err_pw_blank: Your password can’t be only spaces.
join.err_pw_common: That password is too common or easy to guess. Choose another.
join.err_email: Enter a valid email address (for example name@example.com).
join.err_name: Enter your first and last name (up to 100 characters each).
join.err_org: Enter your organization (up to 150 characters; “Independent” if none).
join.err_country: Choose a country from the list.
join.err_province: Choose a valid province or territory.
join.err_student: Student tier: enter your institution (up to 150 characters) and confirm the eligibility attestation.
join.err_tier: Choose a membership tier from the list.
join.err_generic_account: We couldn’t create an account with these details. If you already have an account, sign in first, then continue. Otherwise check the details and try again.
join.alreadyMember: You already have a membership in progress or active, so you can’t join again. Manage it from your dashboard.

join.orderCancelled: Your unpaid order was canceled. Nothing was charged.
join.msg_orderCancelled: Your unpaid order was canceled. Nothing was charged.
join.msg_orderNotFound: We couldn’t find that order on your account. Nothing was charged.
join.msg_orderClosed: That order is no longer open (canceled or expired). You can submit a membership application from Join.
join.msg_ticketNotFound: We couldn’t find that ticket on your account. Nothing was charged.
join.err_state: Choose a valid US state, DC or territory.
join.allRequired: All fields are required unless marked optional.
join.accountHint: You’ll use this email and password to sign in and follow your application.

profile.title: Profile & privacy
profile.emailHint: To change the email you sign in with, contact the ADAIG team.
profile.dataBody: Download a copy of the personal data ADAIG holds about you.
profile.deleteBody: This permanently removes your name, contact details, profile, CPE record and preferences, and signs you out. Any active membership or pending application is canceled. Any payment records (for example, paid event registrations) and the audit log are kept in anonymized form, as required for tax and financial record-keeping (7 years).
profile.deleteConfirm: I understand this can’t be undone
profile.deleteWrong: Password incorrect or confirmation not ticked. Nothing was deleted.
profile.deleteLastAdmin: You are the last admin. Promote another admin before deleting your account.
